description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi
uses.cardState: as Avatar Kyoshi without summoning sickness
